newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Oct 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Oct 15.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories on Tuesday:
- Intel Corp reported $1.31 billion or $1.48 per share in earnings for the third quarter, exceeding market expectations.
- Californian utility companies Enova Corp and Pacific Enterprises plan to merge.
- Rite Aid Corp has agreed to acquire Thrifty Payless Holdings Inc TFYP.OB for $1.3 billion in stock, plus the assumption of debt.
- The Dow Jones industrial average rose past the 6,000 mark to end 40.62 points higher at 6,010 in a strong, bull market.
- Archer Daniels Midland Co has agreed to plead guilty to conspiring with competitors to fix the prices of two agricultural products and pay $100 million in fines.
- AT&T Corp is close to announcing a new president and successor to chairman Robert Allen.
- Chrysler Corp reported third-quarter earnings of $680 million or $0.93 per share.
- Goldman, Sachs & Co is expected to name the firm's first managing directors on Tuesday.
- Carillon Importers Ltd of Grand Metropolitan Plc plans to introduce Stolichnaya flavored vodka to the U.S. liquor market.
- TRW Inc plans to cut 2,300 jobs and close several plants.
